preconditions.description: The size of the array is between 1 and 10^5.
Each integer in the array is greater than 1 and less than or equal to 10^5.

postconditions.expression: output == number of Full binary trees with the given product property
postconditions.description: The output is the number of full binary trees where each non-leaf node's value is the product of its children's values, modulo 1000000007.
